scope.description: A separate follow-up workflow to publish.yml, triggered only after it completes.
constraints: Never pushes to the default branch (main) directly.
Only opens or updates pull requests carrying governance/release-publications/later/ evidence records.
publish.yml's own upload job (contents: read, id-token: write) is unchanged by this grant.

source: The owner replied "approved" to the coordinator's "Permission decision" ask about granting a separate follow-up workflow contents: write and pull-requests: write, with no publish credential, that never pushes to main and only opens evidence pull requests.
note: This decision is scoped to exactly the design described above. It does not authorize broadening this workflow's permissions, granting them to publish.yml itself, or granting them to any other workflow. Two independent blind reviews (security- and correctness-focused, 2026-09-23) subsequently required narrowing this workflow's trust boundary (trigger gating, provenance verification, branch-adoption checks) without changing the permission grant itself; this decision covers that narrowed design unchanged.
